newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps - CFDs touch easier, others steady.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps - CFDs touch easier, others steady.

text.p: European oil swaps trudged sideways on Monday with market liquidity beset by the summertime doldrums.

Brent crude CFDs were broadly weaker by a few cents, particuarly further, out in response to a weaker Dated Brent deal late on Friday, while gasoline, which has recently been in the driving seat, showed very marginal gains.
Naphtha was effectively unchanged, as was fuel.
Brent CFDs for July 28 to August 1 were pegged at +4 cents against September Brent compared with +12 cents on Friday and August 4-8 at -2 cents against September from -6 cents.
Augsut 11-15 was broadly steady at -12 cents, but August 18-22 weakened sharply to -22 cents from -13 cents.
Heavy fuel was flat with August hoverng around $90 and September 50 cents to $1 contangoed. Rotterdam refinery material sold at $91 fob.

Gasoline swaps were steady to very narrowly firmer with August pegged around $199.25 and September backwardated to $192.50. Dealers said the physical market was still finely balanced and extra demand could turn supplies very tight.
Gas oil crack spreads saw 4Q steady at $4.40, 1Q at $4.45 and 2Q at $4.00.
